scope: 27 public first-party source entries; native HTTP feed/list plus sample body/date checks. Not a guarantee of continuous availability or an independent audit of claimed business outcomes.

methodology.transport: Normal public HTTP GET using the environment network egress; no login, cookies, anti-bot bypass, browser rendering or source API keys.
methodology.xml: ElementTree confirms RSS/Atom structure and counts entries; published and updated are recorded separately.
methodology.html: Static HTML inspected with lxml; default-source CSS selectors and body/date extraction then verified with the actual application linkedom/Readability parser using the original saved responses.
methodology.bodyChars: Length of normalized static article/main text where present; otherwise page text excluding script/style/nav/header/footer. A size check alone is not proof of complete article extraction.
methodology.date: Prefer original page datePublished / article:published_time / visible original date, then publisher feed pubDate. updated is never silently relabeled as publication date. Unknown remains null.
methodology.failedFetches: Failures are recorded, not replaced by successful search-engine rendering. Only original feed content may be used as a disclosed feed_excerpt fallback.
methodology.privacy: No credentials, proxy values, tokens or user data are stored in this audit.
